date.as_written: samvat 823 āśvinamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyāṃ tithāv ādityavāre

notes: Scribe statement in Sanskrit: Devaśaṅkara Śarman, of brahmin (vipra) family, son of Gaṇapati Śarman, wrote (alīlikhat) this Gaṅgādharī ṭīkā; matches catalogue scribe field. 'śrīdevaśaṅkaraśarmmāmūṃ' = śarmmā + imāṃ (imūṃ, error). 'svanimhavantāgṛhanivāsito' is obscure: apparently 'residing in the house/quarter of svanimhavantā', possibly a corrupt local (Newari) place or house name; left unnormalized. Year 823 taken as NS (Newari script, Nepalese context), Āśvina kṛṣṇa 10 Sunday ≈ autumn 1703 CE (or late 1702 depending on reckoning). Gaṅgādhara Śarman is the commentator, not a party to this copy.
